scope: offline strict-OOF Meta objective selection; not an MC1 or live promotion
target: strict-prequential rich-policy-net residual in bps, ordinalized with train-only quantile grades
selection_rule: Maximize SStableMeta subject to conditional MI remaining within a practical range of the best duration; do not select on standalone portfolio EV.
boundary: F72 plus causal market-wide mkt/IQR/eigen/spectral/cross-sectional distribution fields. No new funding, order-book, liquidity or asset-level context fields. Declared continuous-regime and soft-transition fields are excluded from this comparable run because their historical sidecars are incomplete; no values are imputed.
